Format requests

Providers pick a format from the User-Agent. Auto keeps requesting the format the current profiles came from and tries the others only when it stops working. A subscription without profiles first requests the same link once per format, at most three times, and keeps the format with the most profiles this app can import. Stored profiles that another format or User-Agent does not match are replaced only after you agree. A custom User-Agent replaces format requests, and a provider may ignore them. Routing, DNS and proxy groups are not imported.
